title.narrative: Monitoring of the implementation of the agreements

description.narrative: Upon successful conclusion of the agreements EUIndia FTA, Agreement on Geographical Indications and an Agreement on Investment Protection, the contractor will contribute to an efficient and effective monitoring of the implementation of these agreement(s) by means of: 2 business surveys that will aim to reflect business sentiment in relation to the FTA, IPA and GI (i.e. perception of the EUIndia business environment). 3 sectoral / thematic studies that will provide more in depth information on the opening of the market in India as well as emerging business opportunities and emerging trade barriers. 2 dissemination events in India (including in the format of EU pavilions in Trade fairs) to raise awareness of the benefits and opportunities brought about by the FTA as well as its ongoing evolution.
